description: register.tsx nudges wherever a surface draws UI: a pane (or a band when the terminal is narrow) on the terminal, a card above the chat in the desktop Code tab, and sets COMPACT_NUDGE_MODULE=1 at session start. nudge.py is the command-hook fallback for every other session (no function hooks, -p, SDK): it exits at once when COMPACT_NUDGE_MODULE=1 and only emits a systemMessage at Stop. The launcher tries python3, then python, then py -3 (Windows installs without python3); '|| true' keeps a missing interpreter from ever blocking a turn.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/nudge.py" reset 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/nudge.py" reset 2>/dev/null || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/nudge.py" reset 2>/dev/null || true
